title: Retention Incident Runway & Escalation Brief
body:
Purpose:
This brief defines a short, operational "runway" for accounts identified as at-risk during the quarter (QBR input or health-signal). It combines a fast triage checklist with a 21-day action runway, an escalation ladder for exec involvement, and templated save plays for AMs and solutions engineers. Designed to be used live in customer-success sprint rooms and shared with Sales/Customer Engineering when escalation is requested.

Scope and audience:
- Audience: CSMs, AMs, Head of Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, GTM execs.
- Scope: mid-market and enterprise accounts with >$50k ARR, renewal window <= 90 days, or triggered by product/regression signals.

Quick signal matrix (one-page):
1) Product signals (weighted): 40%
   - 7d DAU drop > 35% (score 8)
   - Key route latency regressions/failed inference > 3% (score 7)
   - New error class post-deploy affecting critical endpoints (score 9)
2) Usage/financial: 30%
   - Seat churn requests or license downgrades (score 8)
   - Consumption down >50% mono-week (score 6)
3) Relationship/Risk: 30%
   - CSM sentiment negative in last 3 interactions (score 7)
   - Exec absence from scheduled QBRs (score 5)

Risk score = sum(product*0.4 + usage*0.3 + relationship*0.3) normalized to 0-100.
Thresholds: Low <30, Medium 30-60, High >60. High -> initiate 21-day runway.

21-day runway (phases):
- Day 0 (Triage): Owner CSM opens incident doc, assigns AM and SE, notifies Head of CS. Attach QBR notes and last 30d telemetry snapshot.
- Days 1-7 (Stabilize): Technical quick wins: config rollback, routing to a fallback model variant, KV cache flush, tokenization/segment fixes. Communications: Daily AM check-in email to customer with clear list of fixes and ETA.
- Days 8-14 (Mitigate): Launch 'save plays' (see templates). Consider temporary discounts or credits for critical outages. If unresolved, prepare exec escalation pack (1 pager + telemetry + proposed remediation + ask).
- Days 15-21 (Decision): Either close runway (improved metrics + renewal commitment) or escalate to Exec meeting + renewal arm's-length plan (legal + sales coordination).

Escalation ladder (who to pull):
- Level 1: CSM + Customer Success Manager Lead (AM). Internal slack channel: #cs-risk.
- Level 2: Solutions Engineer + Product Technical Lead (for runtime/kernel issues). Create GH issue and link telemetry.
- Level 3: Head of CS + Head of Product + Head of Infra (exec briefing). Schedule 48-hour briefing window.
- Level 4: CEO/CRO brief only if >$1M ARR at risk or strategic partnership.

Save plays catalog (select based on root cause):
- Performance regression (latency/cost): Route to lower-latency region or fallback quantized model; enable aggressive batching for non-real-time flows; provision temporary dedicated pool for 7–14 days.
- Quality regression (generation drift): Revert to last known-good model version; apply prompt guardrails and temporary post-processing rules; run golden prompt set and share evals with customer.
- Billing/consumption dispute: Immediate temporary credits, open joint audit, freeze prorated billing while audit is completed.
- Trust/comms breakdown: Offer executive QBR, dedicated office hours, and a 30-day SLA extension for observability retention.

Templates (use verbatim, personalize):
- AM daily update subject: "Status update: [Account] — Day [n] of retention runway"
  Body: short bullets: issue summary, action taken, blockers, ETA, ask for customer.
- Exec escalation one-pager: 1) TL;DR impact + quant (tokens, revenue at risk), 2) Root cause hypothesis, 3) Actions taken, 4) Proposed remediation + ask (resources/privileges), 5) Customer impact statement, 6) Meeting request times.

QBR input checklist (to populate the runway doc):
- Renewal window date and ARR
- Last 3 customer interactions summary with sentiment tags
- 30/60/90 day usage trend (tokens and active routes)
- Top 3 technical incidents in last 90 days + status
- Contractual penalties or credits in place

Action tracker (simple lines for quick paste into a sheet):
- action_id | owner | due_date | status | notes
- e.g. RUN-001 | Priya Kothari | 2024-12-05 | in_progress | reordered routing to quantized variant

Decision rules and communications:
- If by Day 7 product signals are not improved by 30% -> escalate to Level 2 and schedule SE-led deep dive within 48 hours.
- If by Day 14 relationship signals unchanged and consumption still down -> prepare exec one-pager and Sales handoff.
- All customer-facing commitments must include measurable acceptance criteria (e.g., latency < 200ms p50 on primary route).

Notes and open questions (working-room):
- Should we auto-trigger runway for accounts with duplicated health signals across two categories? Propose YES for >$250k ARR.
- Need a lightweight telemetry snapshot export script for AMs (ask infra for an adhoc endpoint).

Appendix: quick scripts & links
- Telemetry query template: CONFLUENCE-RI-421 -> contains sample queries and dashboards.
- Past case studies: see JIRA-CUST-1150 (successful escalation -> regained 86% of baseline consumption).

Next steps (owner: Priya):
1) Iterate templates with AMs (by 2024-12-09).
2) Run tabletop drill with SEs and Head of CS (by 2025-01-10).
3) Build a single-click "open runway" button in CS Console (request to product via CONFLUENCE-RI-421).

-- end of brief --
